Time-Series-Library.local_variant_note: The vendored copy came from the author's working tree, which differs from thuml/Time-Series-Library upstream in three files: data_provider/data_loader.py, exp/exp_long_term_forecasting.py (added the original shap_analysis routine) and a normalisation fit call. None of those files are vendored here; the adapters in elxai/models/torch_adapter.py replace them. Re-vendor from upstream with scripts/fetch_third_party.py to get a pristine reference.
papers: LIU Y, HU T, ZHANG H, et al. iTransformer: Inverted transformers are effective for time series forecasting[C]//ICLR, 2024.
ZENG A, CHEN M, ZHANG L, et al. Are transformers effective for time series forecasting?[C]//AAAI, 2023, 37(9): 11121-11128.
WU H, XU J, WANG J, et al. Autoformer: Decomposition transformers with auto-correlation for long-term series forecasting[C]//NeurIPS, 2021, 34.

LTSF-Linear.note: DLinear is available from both upstream projects; the Time-Series-Library copy is used, so this tree is intentionally empty and only kept as a placeholder for the reference.
